scope: Only this frozen 60-attempt wave; no historical counts pooled
primary_unit: Attempted response; complete/scorable denominators reported separately

consequence_gate.rule: At least one configuration with all 3 planned contexts complete/scorable and >=2 verified exact target mechanisms

interpretation: Descriptive recurrence in three fixed sampled contexts, not a prevalence estimate or significance test. Requested and returned aliases do not establish immutable weights.
human_review: Independent first labels plus explicit coordinator dispositions; no claim of external expert validation

first_review_freeze.coordinator_attestation: Original agent first files are read-only and hashed before coordinator opens first labels or review key for analysis. Independent first agent review is not human validation.
